message.content: According to the conversation records, Yuriko did indeed inform Li Hua about her plans to meet at "Central Perk" café for their next discussion. Specifically, Yuriko reached out to Li Hua on February 25th at 15:00 (UTC), reminding him about their scheduled meeting on March 6th at 2:00 PM to discuss the homepage updates. Li Hua responded positively, confirming his availability and expressing excitement about the meeting at "Central Perk". This indicates that Yuriko had already booked a seat at the café before Li Hua sent a follow-up message to confirm the details.
